platform_attribution.fact: Upstream v5.10 psb_drv.c PCI table maps Intel 0x8086 devices 0x8108 and 0x8109 to psb_chip_ops. psb_drv.h identifies these as Poulsbo, distinct from Moorestown/Medfield/Cedarview. psb_device.c selects PSB_SGX_OFFSET for those ops.
platform_attribution.rev121_observation: UNKNOWN: upstream source does not identify SGX535 core revision 121; direct hardware qualification of these field semantics remains required.

facts.meaning: Header supplies sixteen USE code-base MMIO register slots starting at offset 0x0a0c with four-byte register stride. This is the MMIO register-address stride, not instruction width.
Header supplies a two-bit data-master field at bit25, a 25-bit base-address field, and address-alignment shift7. Header comment questions the 1024-bit-alignment description.
facts.interpretation: Treat 128-byte base alignment as INFERRED hardware semantics pending direct verification. It does not establish instruction alignment or register index encoding.
facts.packing_interpretation: ADDR_SHIFT is0 while ALIGNSHIFT is7. Pure candidate packing address>>7 into low25 bits is an INFERRED interpretation; no execution or upstream call-site corroboration found.

facts.meaning: Header names PDS execution base MMIO register offset0x0ab8 and defines address/alignment shifts20 with explicit one-megabyte alignment comment.
facts.interpretation: Source-level PDS base-window alignment metadata only; PDS program instruction alignment/length/data-store layout remain UNKNOWN.
facts.packing_interpretation: ADDR_SHIFT and ALIGNSHIFT both20; psb_drv.c supplies literal0x20000000 directly to register. Preserve raw aligned VA as register word; do not right-shift by20 merely because macro is named SHIFT. Header does not supply explicit address mask.

facts.meaning: Public kernel initialization writes 0x20000000 to PDS_EXEC_BASE and 0x30000000 to BIF_3D_REQ_BASE. The actual written register word is reported; no shift convention is guessed from macro names.
facts.interpretation: This source initialization does not prove launch descriptor layout, program contents, executable shaders, current MMIO state or rev121-specific correctness.

facts.meaning: Header names EVENT_KICKER MMIO register0x0ac4 and shift4 with 128-bit aligned address comment.
facts.interpretation: Event-address metadata only. It is not a USSE/PDS instruction or authorized experiment.
